## Why this study was run

**Research question:** [When do promising signals fail?](../questions/failure-conditions.qmd); [How far can query-only routing go?](../questions/query-only-routing.qmd)

Test local domain priors and matched-neighbor cluster aggregation.

**Rationale:** Reconstructed from the issue-13 result and matched-support preflight receipts.

## Protocol and comparison

**Hypothesis:** Aggregating evidence within semantic query clusters improves the dense control.

Evaluate the local prior and bounded hard-cluster or matched-neighbor preflights.

Any run comparison below is partitioned by ledger evaluation scope.

## Current result

**Outcome:** `mixed`

The local prior was negative and preflight variants remained diagnostic.

## Decision and rationale

**Decision:** `reject`

Do not replace dense retrieval with the tested cluster aggregations.

Rationale provenance: `reconstructed`.

## Evidence limits

Development-only aggregate evidence; preflights are diagnostic and adaptive exploration may overfit.

Development results do not establish hidden-test effectiveness.
